auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

find_invoice.name: find_invoice
find_invoice.description: Search for an invoice by its number in QuickBooks.

invoice_number.description: The document number (DocNumber) of the invoice to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single QuickBooks invoice by its document number (DocNumber), returning the first match. Use to resolve an invoice reference to its full record before reading or acting on it; the document number is required. Read-only and idempotent.

find_customer.name: find_customer
find_customer.description: Search for a customer by display name in QuickBooks.

search_term.description: The display name of the customer to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single QuickBooks customer by exact display name, returning the first match. Use to resolve a customer name to its full record (including its Id) before referencing it elsewhere; the match is exact, not fuzzy. Read-only and idempotent.

find_payment.name: find_payment
find_payment.description: Finds an existing payment in QuickBooks.

customerId.description: The ID of the customer to find payments for.

aiMetadata.description: List all QuickBooks payments belonging to a given customer, identified by the customer Id (not name). Use to retrieve a customer's payment history or to check whether they have any payments on record. Read-only and idempotent.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

amount.description: Total amount for this line (Exclusive of tax). Required.

itemId.description: Enter the ID of the Item (Product/Service). Required for SalesItemLineDetail.

unitPrice.description: If specified, Amount will be Qty * UnitPrice. If Amount is also specified, Amount overrides calculation.

emailStatus.description: Specify whether the invoice should be emailed after creation.

billEmail.description: Email address to send the invoice to. Required if Email Status is "Needs To Be Sent". Overrides customer default.

dueDate.description: The date when the payment for the invoice is due. If not provided, default term from customer or company is used.

docNumber.description: Optional reference number for the invoice. If not provided, QuickBooks assigns the next sequential number.

txnDate.description: The date entered on the transaction. Defaults to the current date if not specified.

privateNote.description: Note to self. Does not appear on the invoice sent to the customer.

customerMemo.description: Memo to be displayed on the invoice sent to the customer (appears on statement).

aiMetadata.description: Create a new QuickBooks invoice for a customer with one or more line items (each line needs an amount and an Item/product Id). Optionally set due date, transaction date, invoice number, memos, and email status; setting email status to "Needs To Be Sent" requires a billing email. Not idempotent: each call creates a new invoice, so guard against duplicates.

create_expense.name: create_expense
create_expense.description: Creates an expense transaction (purchase) in QuickBooks.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

accountRef.description: The account from which the expense was paid.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

entityRef.description: Optional - The vendor the expense was paid to.

lineItems.description: Details of the expense (e.g., categories or items purchased). At least one line is required.

expenseAccountId.description: The Id of the expense account. Use the "Find Account" action (filter by type Expense) to look this up.

aiMetadata.description: Record a new expense (purchase) paid from a chosen bank or credit-card account, with one or more account-based line items (each needs an amount and an expense account Id) and a payment type of cash, check, or credit card. Optionally attach a payee/vendor, payment date, and memo. Not idempotent: each call creates a new purchase, so guard against duplicates.

create_bill.name: create_bill
create_bill.description: Creates a bill (accounts payable) in QuickBooks.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

lineItems.description: Details of the bill (expense categories). At least one line is required.

expenseAccountId.description: The Id of the expense account. Use the "Find Account" action (filter by type Expense) to look this up.

txnDate.description: The date of the bill. Defaults to today if empty.

dueDate.description: The date the payment is due. If empty, the vendor/company term is used.

aiMetadata.description: Record a new bill owed to a vendor, with one or more account-based line items (each needs an amount and an expense account Id). Optionally set the bill date, due date, bill number, and memo. Not idempotent: each call creates a new bill, so guard against duplicates.

find_vendor.name: find_vendor
find_vendor.description: Search for a vendor by display name in QuickBooks.

search_term.description: The display name of the vendor to search for.

aiMetadata.description: Look up a single QuickBooks vendor by exact display name, returning the first match. Use to resolve a vendor name to its full record (including its Id) before referencing it elsewhere; the match is exact, not fuzzy. Read-only and idempotent.

find_account.name: find_account
find_account.description: List or search the chart of accounts to get an account Id (e.g. an expense account for a bill).

search_term.description: Optional. Filter accounts whose name contains this text.

aiMetadata.description: List QuickBooks chart-of-accounts entries to resolve an account name to its Id. Optionally filter by a name substring and/or account type (e.g. Expense, Bank, Accounts Payable). Use this to find the expense-account Id required by Create Bill / Create Expense line items. Read-only and idempotent.

record_payment.name: record_payment
record_payment.description: Records a customer payment in QuickBooks, optionally applying it to invoices.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the payment received.

lineItems.description: Optional. Apply this payment to specific invoices. Leave empty to keep the amount unapplied.

invoiceId.description: The transaction Id of the invoice to apply the payment to.

amount.description: The amount of this payment to apply to the invoice.

depositToAccountId.description: Optional. The account to deposit the payment into. Defaults to Undeposited Funds if empty.

txnDate.description: The date the payment was received. Defaults to today if empty.

paymentRefNum.description: Optional reference number for the payment (e.g. check number).

aiMetadata.description: Record a payment received from a customer for a given total amount. Optionally apply the payment to one or more specific invoices by their transaction Id, set the deposit-to account, payment date, and reference number. If no invoices are specified, QuickBooks leaves the amount unapplied. Not idempotent: each call creates a new payment, so guard against duplicates.

read_aging_report.name: read_aging_report
read_aging_report.description: Reads an accounts receivable or accounts payable aging report from QuickBooks.

reportDate.description: The date to age balances against. Defaults to today if empty.

agingPeriod.description: Number of days in each aging bucket (e.g. 30).

numPeriods.description: How many aging buckets to include.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch an aging report showing outstanding receivables (money owed to the company) or payables (money the company owes), bucketed by how overdue they are. Choose the report type, optionally set the as-of date, the number of days per aging bucket, and the number of buckets. Read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can find Company ID under **settings->Additional Info**.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_invoice.name: new_invoice
new_invoice.description: Triggers when an invoice is created .

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new invoice is created in the connected QuickBooks company, emitting the newly created invoice record. Use to react to billing being issued to a customer.

new_expense.name: new_expense
new_expense.description: Triggers when an Expense (Purchase) is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new expense (purchase transaction) is created in the connected QuickBooks company, emitting the newly created purchase record. Use to react to money being spent or a bill being recorded.

new_customer.name: new_customer
new_customer.description: Triggers when a new customer is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new customer is created in the connected QuickBooks company, emitting the newly created customer record. Use to react to a new customer being added to the books.

new_deposit.name: new_deposit
new_deposit.description: Triggers when a Deposit is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new deposit is created in the connected QuickBooks company, emitting the newly created deposit record. Use to react to funds being deposited into an account.

new_transfer.name: new_transfer
new_transfer.description: Triggers when a Transfer is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new transfer is created in the connected QuickBooks company, emitting the newly created transfer record. Use to react to funds being moved between two accounts.

pt.Optional reference number for the invoic: Número de referência opcional para a fatura. Se não fornecido, QuickBooks atribui o próximo número sequencial.
pt.The date entered on the transaction. Def: A data inserida na transação. O padrão é a data atual se não for especificado.
pt.Note to self. Does not appear on the inv: Nota para si mesmo. Não aparece na fatura enviada ao cliente.
pt.Memo to be displayed on the invoice sent: O memorando a ser exibido na fatura enviada ao cliente (aparece na declaração).
pt.The account from which the expense was p: A conta a partir da qual a despesa foi paga.
pt.Optional - The vendor the expense was pa: Opcional - O fornecedor para o qual a despesa foi paga.
A data em que ocorreu a despesa.
pt.Details of the expense (e.g., categories: Detalhes da despesa (por exemplo, categorias ou itens comprados). Pelo menos uma linha é necessária.
pt.Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
pt.HEAD: CABEÇA
Aciona quando uma fatura é criada.
pt.Triggers when an Expense (Purchase) is c: Aciona quando uma despesa (Purchase) é criada.
Dispara quando um novo cliente é criado.
Dispara quando um depósito é criado.
Dispara quando uma transferência é criada.
